Craft/production details as news: GHOST RIDER shot on film with Linus Sandgren — 1.86M views, 59.8k likes (best like count of the day)
Values-driven quotes travel: LAIKA's Travis Knight 'AI is theft' — 761k views, 7.5k reposts (most reposted)
Legacy returns: Jennifer Lawrence back as Katniss in SUNRISE ON THE REAPING — 732k + 404k on FilmUpdates, 230k on DiscussingFilm
Reimaginings of classics: HBO's THE BIRDS series (1.14M), new FRIDAY movie (372k), PRIDE & PREJUDICE trailer (116k)
Casting scoops in pairs: Connor Storrie in talks for GHOST RIDER villain — 776k (FilmUpdates) + 622k (DiscussingFilm) within a minute
Awards-season lists: Gotham Awards nominations carousels (108k, 92k, 85k), COYOTE VS ACME Oscar submission (690k)

narrative_synthesis: Trailers and the Dune: Part 3 rollout carried the day: DIG's first trailer hit 4.75M and the Dune final trailer 4.34M on DiscussingFilm, with the Leto II/Ghanima first look adding 1.53M. Ghost Rider news (shot on film, Connor Storrie as villain) and LAIKA's anti-AI stance drew the strongest engagement, and Jennifer Lawrence's Katniss return led FilmUpdates.
